title: Why Asimov's Laws of Robotics Don't Work - Computerphile
summary: Rob Miles explains for Computerphile why simple rule sets like Asimov's Three Laws cannot make robots and AI safe. Terms like harm and human are too ambiguous to specify precisely.
why: Pointed to in AI safety debates as a short explanation of why encoding human values as simple rules is so hard.

quote.text: I found this video insightful on the matter from Computerphile
